comparison.interpretation: Immutable portable-data bounds are weakly certified per schema and node, with live type-name inventories and conservative host serializer fallback. Every occurrence still contributes its exact node/character/depth bounds, and schema/factory validation remains live. A checked shared frame may be reused only for a clean single native text transaction after freshly rereading its full edited stream and proving all other shared types and existing styles unchanged. Every schema/factory rule and final model check still runs. Transaction identity, insertion state and deletions gate cache freshness; explicit reads, remote/structural edits and uncertain cases acquire full shared state. Diagnostic timings, not adoption gates. Normalization, preflight, history growth, compaction and migration remain. No default switch, version/limit increase or publication.
